what_this_is: Record of the aixm52 fixtures: SHA-256 and byte count of every fixture file, written 2026-09-21 by adapter-expansion phase 6 (`spec/build_fixtures.py --pin`). The normative schema closure itself is held OUTSIDE the repository (normative_binding `aixm52`, xsd_pin.json there, made offline-resolvable by its OASIS catalog; decision D2) and is not mirrored here. Every fixture is written by spec/build_fixtures.py (`--check` CURRENT), which is why no independent/ directory exists: no independent AIXM 5.2 data set was pinned in Phase 0 (record: Remaining gaps).
